title: Broke in Chicago after leaving Meroff
summary: Having saved nothing, he finds little work in 1931, some bosses cannot pay, and he lands a job in a burlesque theater.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Now, we're going back to when you left Meroff . ---

Yeah - in '31-- And, so, here I am back in Chicago and I checked in a hotel and I-- of course, with all thatmoney I made, I didn't save any--- I always figured - tomorrow is another day. So, then, I found the picking a little tough right now and I even jobbed around in places where the boss would come at the end of the night - and say, I'm sorry fellows -- we didn't make enough to pay you - you know - it was just that tough. And, so, of course, I won't tell you about all the things and the ways that we lived at that time. Of course, that only happened to me a short time---
Yeah - that was a matter of a few weeks - wasn't it?

Well, it was a couple of months really -- of very tough things. And, then, I got a job in the burlesque theater in Chicago. That was very unusual - that was a theater on -- where all the musicians hung out on -- there's a certain street by the Oriental Theater -- I can't think of the name of the street now---
